title: Signal: Requirement pinned with a version wildcard
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
limitations: It matches an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
